claim_reviews.conclusion: “Menstrual cramps” and “pain during menstruation” are aligned and sufficiently precise.
claim_reviews.subject: English cue and sense

claim_reviews.conclusion: The answer is semantically appropriate Indonesian for menstrual cramps; Indonesian health guidance describes menstrual pain with “kram” and “menstruasi.”
claim_reviews.subject: Indonesian answer: kram menstruasi

claim_reviews.conclusion: “Senggugut” is a valid Malaysian Malay term for menstrual pain/dysmenorrhoea.
claim_reviews.subject: Malaysian answer: senggugut

claim_reviews.conclusion: The split is materially overstated because “senggugut” is also recorded in Indonesian as menstrual pain/dysmenorrhoea, so it is not Malaysia-exclusive. “Kram menstruasi” remains a valid Indonesian expression, but the answers overlap in accepted usage.
claim_reviews.subject: Cross-variety overlap

claim_reviews.conclusion: The relation is not supportable as an unqualified different-common-word contrast. A qualified preference contrast may be defensible, but national exclusivity or strong variety separation is not established.
claim_reviews.evidence_limitation: The cited dictionaries and official health material establish cross-variety acceptance but do not provide comparable frequency data sufficient to quantify which form is more common in each national variety.
claim_reviews.subject: Final relation: different-common-word

claim_reviews.conclusion: No false-friend contrast is present in the learner content, and the two answers are near-equivalent terms rather than a demonstrated false-friend pair.
claim_reviews.evidence_limitation: The supplied card has an empty contrast field; no independent false-friend distinction can be validated.
claim_reviews.subject: False-friend contrast

response.rationale: The national split is materially overstated: “senggugut” is an accepted Indonesian dictionary word for menstrual pain as well as an ordinary Malaysian Malay term. The Indonesian answer is valid, but the pair should not be presented as a clean different-common-word contrast without qualification. No false-friend contrast is supplied.
